parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with printed maps. It has a diameter of about 25 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information and can be rotated to view different regions of the world.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its tilted axis supported by the base structure.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of plastic, with a circular stand approximately 15 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the rotating sphere, keeping the globe upright.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the sphere rotates above it.
